question: Should ClawHub adopt this compatibility-preserving duplicate-case rejection now, including `PROTOCOL.md` collision enforcement, once the branch is rebased?
rationale: The code path is repair-shaped, but the change deliberately rejects some previously accepted skill packages and extends enforcement to a partly undefined package-file scope.

options.title: Rebase and adopt this policy
options.body: Confirm the compatibility-preserving collision rule, preserve current staged publish changes during rebase, and continue normal merge review.

options.title: Narrow to readme collisions
options.body: Ask for the PR to reject only `SKILL.md`/`skill.md`/`skills.md` collisions until `PROTOCOL.md` is explicitly documented as package contract.

options.title: Defer policy enforcement
options.body: Leave the linked issue open for a migration/docs plan before changing publish/import acceptance.

recommendation.title: Rebase and adopt this policy
recommendation.body: Confirm the compatibility-preserving collision rule, preserve current staged publish changes during rebase, and continue normal merge review.
